correctness.rationale: The inverse-branch formulas give a four-by-four transfer matrix on discontinuous cellwise affine coefficients. The invariant mass row J and fixed vector r satisfy JP=J, Pr=r, Jr=1. Characteristic roots on ker J are -phi^-2 and phi^-2 exp(±2πi/3), all with sixth power phi^-12 and distinct, yielding the sixth-power identity and L1 equality. For g=(x-mu)rho in ker J, covariance is integral (x-mu)P^n g; six exactly evaluated phases determine all lag n. Independent symbolic SymPy calculations reconstructed P^6 and twelve covariance coefficients, rather than trusting old output.
